targets.authors: Darcy, I., Mora, J. C., & Daidone, D.
targets.title: The role of inhibitory control in second language phonological processing
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, the current study is a close replication of DM&D, with the variable modification of additional tests of inhibitory control measuring prepotent response inhibition.
targets.outcome_quote: Specifically, DM&D found that learners with higher inhibitory control were more accurate in vowel perception and consonant production. No clear relationship was found between vowel production and inhibitory control, and consonant perception was not able to be tested. Results of the current replication for the partial correlation analyses did not indicate statistically significant relationships, and effect sizes were small with 95% CIs crossing through zero.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The central correlations reported in the original were not found; descriptive sample comparability and task-level RT patterns are ancillary, not successful replications of the central claim. Possible measurement limitations are discussed without an author verdict that this attempt cannot adjudicate.

reasoning: Title and sole author verified; complete HTML article and references available. A completed close replication with a fresh sample, rather than a prospective preregistration. One published finding paper is targeted.
